text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training today, I brought Tap Dance City to the shopping district.
The reason for this was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I found it!
Found it! So this is the place everyone's talking about...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—A lottery draw!
Now that gets me totally pumped!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A single ticket turns into treasure, right!?
Ooooh, wonderful!
choice_data_list: I had a feeling you'd like it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just the other day, I found out about a lottery while out shopping, and thinking Tap Dance City might enjoy it, I invited her along.
choice_data_list: Try giving it a spin with the ticket I gave you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK,
leave it to me! Our target, of course, is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The grand prize...
It's the jackpot!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Full of excitement,
Tap Dance City cranked the raffle machine's handle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I won!
Getting the best prize means, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's all about making a fortune, right?!
Come on, give it here!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?
choice_data_list: What I won was a hot spring trip, y'know
What I won was a hot spring trip, you know

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Is that so!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hot springs sound nice too!
It feels so very Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can't I just have the hot spring itself?
I'd love to attach it to my castle!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh,
yeeep.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Furo-furo-furo~.
The bath is flowing, in the flow~... Just kidding♪
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.
You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I do love Japanese bath culture, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Since coming here, I've also learned
the fun of going to the public bath with everyone.
Man, that feels so good!
choice_data_list: You should go enjoy the hot springs with your friends too

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!
That sounds awesome—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...No, this is one
I'd like to go to with you."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I feel like a bath is a place
where you can truly open up and speak your mind."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how should I put it...
Yes, in the truest sense.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Once our dream comes true,
I wanna sit down and have a long talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "So I'm using this ticket with you. For what awaits beyond the gold... an encore performance."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: You'll come with me, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then. I'll leave the tickets with you.
I feel like I'd lose them... scratch that, I definitely would!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head back to the academy.
The oasis awaits us somewhere in the future—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Great!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, looks amazing!
Looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Living up to its name, it's turned into the absolute best hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ho?
Well then, we'd better let our friends have some too!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, cut up this hamburg steak
for everyone too!
choice_data_list: Then there won't be any left for Tap.
Then there won't be any left for Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Ah~, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I want to eat it too,
but good food is meant to be shared with everyone.
choice_data_list: Then how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, everyone, help yourselves without holding back!
It's homemade supreme carrot hamburg steaks!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Companions
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh~...!
It's so huuuuuge!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My proposal to Tap Dance City was
to eat the hamburger steak she won herself,
memorize its taste, and--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was to treat her friends to a homemade,
extra-large, premium carrot hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That is seriously huge!
Isn't it like as tall as Tap's height?
...Tap's high-top, gyahaha!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it seriously looks delicious, but...
Did Tap really cook all this alone?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Of course—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer made more than half of it! Ahaha-haha!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I figured as much.
Thanks a bunch, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Here, here, eat it while it's hot!
I took a little nibble, but it's a total recreation!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're amazing.
Why don't you just become my personal chef?
choice_data_list: But you're already my personal navigator?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
Then you'll be navigator and cook!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Operation Special Hamburg Steak was a huge success.
Tap Dance City and the others were thrilled, and lunch passed by in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO~~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So many carrots!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is what I call
a real treasure trove!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...!
A mountain of treasure, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Did you just say... our carrots
are a treasure trove?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter how you look at it,
it's a magnificent mountain of treasure!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful sparkle that rivals any crystal!
Any pirate's eyes would light up seeing this!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~, that makes me happy! 
Alright, I gotta give ya a little something extra!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, just between you and me...
There's a place where we can hoard even more treasure.”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Let me hear it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, this is the field of the farmer
we get our carrots from!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I've smoothed things over with them.
Dig as much as you like, and find that treasure!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wow!
Treasure hunting~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having innocently enjoyed digging for carrots,
Tap Dance City doubled the mountain of carrots she harvested
and brought them back to the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Aaah.
I guess the Dream wasn't meant to be...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, at least one hit the mark!
Better than coming away empty-handed, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Now then, about that carrot...
choice_data_list: It's the only one, so I'll take it home carefully and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Mister, give me one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City split the single carrot in half without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer, this is for you!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What's mine belongs to my crew, too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat together!
Take a big bite!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, through Tap Dance City's kindness, we walked home while munching on raw carrots together.
...My jaw was aching, but she seemed totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!?
Ah, there goes my dream...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"On such a tiny,
little pocket tissue...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rapid English she spat out at the end...
...I decided to pretend I didn't catch it, but her deep disappointment came through loud and clear.
